T1.implementation_approach: Use a design tool to create wireframes and mockups for the problem library interface.
T1.notes: Focus on user-friendly navigation and accessibility.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting problems.
T2.notes: Ensure secure and efficient data handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Design a relational database schema to store problem data.
T3.notes: Consider scalability and indexing for performance.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a user interface for code submission using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
T4.notes: Include syntax highlighting and error feedback.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop a system to evaluate code submissions against test cases.
T5.notes: Ensure isolation and security during code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Design the user profile interface with sections for user details and activity.
T6.notes: Focus on personalization and ease of use.

T7.implementation_approach: Implement backend services for managing user profiles.

T8.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store user information and activity logs.
T8.notes: Ensure data privacy and compliance with regulations.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop a leaderboard interface to display user rankings.
T9.notes: Include filters and sorting options for better user experience.

T10.implementation_approach: Create backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings.
T10.notes: Optimize for real-time updates and performance.

T11.implementation_approach: Design an interface for displaying hints and explanations for problems.
T11.notes: Ensure hints are accessible without revealing full solutions.

T12.implementation_approach: Implement backend services to manage hints and explanations.
T12.notes: Allow for easy updates and additions by content creators.

T13.implementation_approach: Conduct unit and integration tests for problem library features.
T13.notes: Focus on edge cases and user scenarios.

T14.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system for accuracy and security.
T14.notes: Include stress testing for concurrent submissions.

T15.implementation_approach: Perform tests on user profile functionalities including updates and privacy settings.
T15.notes: Ensure compliance with data protection standards.

T16.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionality for correct ranking and display.
T16.notes: Verify real-time updates and data accuracy.

T17.implementation_approach: Test the hints and explanations feature for accessibility and correctness.
T17.notes: Ensure hints are helpful and do not reveal solutions.

T18.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform using cloud services and set up continuous integration and delivery.
T18.notes: Ensure scalability and monitor performance post-deployment.
